Issue Title: OpenAIModel (Responses, TypeScript) sends invalid assistant history shape, rejected by Bedrock Mantle

Description:
### SDK Language

TypeScript

### Steps to Reproduce

The OpenAI Responses adapter serializes assistant history into an invalid `input` item shape when replaying multi-turn conversations without server-side state (`stateful: false`).

For a two-turn conversation, `formatResponsesMessages` in `strands-ts/src/models/openai/responses-adapter.ts` emits the assistant turn as:

```json
{ "role": "assistant", "content": [{ "type": "output_text", "text": "..." }] }
```

This matches neither valid OpenAI `input` shape for an assistant turn:
- `EasyInputMessage` (string content): `{ "role": "assistant", "content": "..." }`
- `ResponseOutputMessage` (full item): requires `type: "message"`, `id`, `status`, and `output_text` with `annotations`.

The emitted object is a bare `{ role, content: [output_text] }` missing all the `ResponseOutputMessage` required fields, so it is not a valid input item. The code cast it away with `as unknown as ResponseInputItem`, and its own comment acknowledged the shape was incomplete.

Reproduce with the Bedrock Mantle integ test `test/integ/models/openai/mantle.test.node.ts > handles reasoning content across multi-turn conversations` (requires live Bedrock Mantle credentials).

### Expected Behavior

Text-only assistant history is serialized as a valid, OpenAI-documented shape and accepted by both OpenAI-hosted and Bedrock Mantle.

### Actual Behavior

Bedrock Mantle's strict Responses schema rejects the request:

```
SubmitRequestFailure: code=-32602, msg=220 validation errors for ResponsesRequest
```

OpenAI-hosted tolerates the malformed shape (fills in / ignores the missing fields), so the bug was invisible there. It only surfaced once PR #3290 made terminal `response.failed` stream events throw instead of finalizing as an empty successful response, which turned the previously-swallowed Mantle rejection into a loud failure.

### Possible Solution

N/A

### Related Issues

The Python SDK has the identical bug at `strands-py/src/strands/models/openai_responses.py` (`_format_request_message_content` emits `output_text` for assistant text); fix both for parity.

Surfaced by #3290.
